rationale.freshness: Polling at 200 Hz IMU / about 32-50 Hz barometer: limits tolerate transport/loop jitter while detecting a stopped sensor. These are diagnostic deadlines, not flight-control limits.
rationale.rest: Broad uncalibrated bench screening around standard gravity 9.80665 m/s2. Failure to meet conditions produces warning, not hardware fault.
rationale.motion: 30 deg/s establishes observable manual rotation; absent motion requests operator action.
rationale.agreement: 3 m/s2 screening in hardware-profile axes. Exceedance is warning because mounting and vibration may differ.
rationale.environment: Broad plausibility window only. Out-of-window values need environmental/reference verification and never alone prove a damaged sensor.
rationale.lease: An active output needs fresh valid USB commands within 750 ms and always expires after at most 2000 ms. Main-loop delays cannot extend the independent timer cutoff.
